thread:
Alex_Sales: Quick transfer — NovaPharm (pharma data, EU-only, HiTouch). Signed last week. Key things:
- Private deployment requested (VPC + KMS).
- Needs EHR connector for test environment (HL7 feed).
- Expected traffic: ~120 QPS during pilot, bursts to 400 QPS.
- Renewal window ~10 months, P0 for retention if onboarding slips.

Short context: Sales secured contract contingent on dedicated infra and SSO with their IdP. Customer flagged data residency and audit requirements during legal review. We pushed for a private deploy + dedicated capacity. Engineering gating items listed below. Passing to CS for onboarding and to triage infra/connector asks with Eng/Support.

Juniper_CSM: Thanks Alex, copying in eng/support. Can you drop the signed SOW and their SOC2 addendum here? Also share who at NovaPharm will be primary contact for onboarding (name + email).

Alex_Sales: Attaching docs link: https://drive.redwood/nova/sow_v1.pdf  Contact: emma.clark@novapharm.com (Head of Integrations). Sales notes: legal requested KMS + audit log retention 7yrs.

Juniper_CSM: Good — next steps from CS side: 1) kickoff call w/ customer + engineering (owners below) 2) collect IdP metadata for SSO 3) validate VPC peering options / firewall rules 4) plan pilot perf test schedule.

Mike_Support: I can take the VPC peering checklist and assist with firewall rules and onboarding runbooks. Can someone confirm whether private control plane will be used or fully air-gapped on-prem? That changes steps.

Alex_Sales: It's private control plane (customer wants managed but within their VPC). Not air-gapped.

Anya_Eng: For the EHR HL7 connector I'll need: sample payload, expected auth method, and whether messages are batched or streaming. Also need target latency SLO for EHR writes. With 120–400 QPS we should size dedicated pool (possible GPU + CPU proxies).

Juniper_CSM: Emma confirmed HL7 over MLLP, basic auth initially (we will move to mTLS after pilot). SLO: < 250ms end-to-end for API responses, background writes can be async.

Mike_Support: Action items I have so far:
- Create support ticket with infra checklist + assign to infra on-call (owner: Mike_Support)
- Produce firewall/VPC peering doc for Novapharm (ETA: 48h)
- Share runbook template for private control plane onboarding (ETA: 72h)

Anya_Eng: Action items for Eng:
- Create eng ticket for HL7 connector (owner: Anya_Eng) — need sample payload & auth details
- Capacity planning doc for dedicated pool (owner: Anya_Eng) — will recommend instance types and initial replica counts; will estimate cost impact for customer
- KV/prefix caching plan to reduce token churn for EHR prompts (owner: Anya_Eng)

Juniper_CSM: Owners & timelines (agreed):
- CS kickoff + schedule meeting: Juniper_CSM (ETA: tomorrow EOD)
- Collect IdP metadata & credentials: Emma/Novapharm + Juniper_CSM (ETA: 72h)
- Infra checklist + VPC runbook: Mike_Support (ETA: 48h)
- Eng HL7 connector + capacity plan: Anya_Eng (initial draft ETA: 5 business days)

Alex_Sales: Flagging risk: if Eng can't deliver connector in pilot window (4 weeks), customer may push to delay and reassess renewal. Please escalate if timelines slip.

Juniper_CSM: Noted — I'll set weekly syncs and escalate to product/ops if any blocker >48h. Also collecting onboarding success metrics to report back to Sales (time-to-first-query, 95p latency, error rate).

Mike_Support: Creating support ticket now and adding checklist. Ticket: SUP-8842. Link: https://support.redwood/t/SUP-8842

DeployBot: Meeting scheduled: "NovaPharm Onboarding Kickoff" — Wed 10:00 AM UTC — invites sent to Alex_Sales, Juniper_CSM, Mike_Support, Anya_Eng, emma.clark@novapharm.com

Juniper_CSM: Great. I'll run the kickoff and capture notes in the onboarding tracker. If anyone needs to reassign owners, ping here. :raised_hands:

Alex_Sales: Thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll monitor from sales side and be on-call for exec touchpoints if needed. :thumbsup:

Anya_Eng: I'll post the initial capacity recommendations in the eng ticket when ready. If we need a short spike to validate the HL7 parser, I can schedule a 1-day spike this week.

Mike_Support: Got it. Closing loop once runbook is uploaded.

Juniper_CSM: Closing notes — primary next immediate deliverables: VPC runbook (48h), IdP metadata collection (72h), eng draft capacity & connector ticket (5bd). I'll post the kickoff notes after the call.

Alex_Sales: +1. All set.
